title: The super El Niño is cooking coral reefs — can lullabies and probiotics save them?
title_zh: 超级厄尔尼诺正在烹饪珊瑚礁——摇篮曲与益生菌能否拯救它们？
abstract: Researchers are trying everything they can to help coral reefs to survive severe heat stress from climate change, including playing sounds underwater.
abstract_zh: 研究人员正在尝试一切可能的方法，帮助珊瑚礁抵御气候变化导致的严重热应激，包括在水下播放声音。
snippet: Researchers are trying everything they can to help coral reefs to survive severe heat stress from climate change, including playing sounds underwater.
